summary: ScheduleHandle.Describe() returns ScheduleWorkflowAction with zero-value Priority field even when the schedule was created with priority settings. The fix requires calling the existing convertFromPBPriority() function in scheduleActionFromProto.
userImpact: Users calling ScheduleHandle.Describe() receive schedules with empty Priority fields even when priority was set during creation, breaking schedule inspection and management workflows.
rootCause: The scheduleActionFromProto function in internal_schedule_client.go omits the Priority field when building ScheduleWorkflowAction, despite the convertFromPBPriority conversion function already existing.
proposedFix: Add Priority: convertFromPBPriority(workflow.GetPriority()), to the ScheduleWorkflowAction struct construction in scheduleActionFromProto.
keyQuote: convertFromPBPriority already exists — it just isn't called here.
